title: Paired-Acquisition Neural Factorization for Computational Pathology
description: A corrected representation-level study of Paired-Acquisition Neural Factorization (PA-NF) using matched multi-scanner acquisitions. The release reports capacity-matched SCORPION evidence and a corrected independent multi-scanner canine SCC audit, including the negative result that the neural feature space did not establish an increment over strong simple scanner-removal baselines. The supported conclusion is partial structured separation under the tested protocols, not pure disentanglement, complete scanner invariance, diagnostic improvement, or clinical utility.
